description:
Companion codegen bundle for vidocq-runtime-heisenberg-fault-tolerance-extension.
        Declare this artifact in <annotationProcessorPaths> whenever the
        application depends on the Fault Tolerance extension; Maven resolves the
        transitive APT dependencies below automatically.
        Runs Heisenberg's processor on the application's classes: each bean whose methods
        carry @Retry, @Timeout, @CircuitBreaker, @Bulkhead, @Fallback or @Asynchronous
        gets a $$HeisenbergPolicies companion holding them, so the runtime reads them
        without reflection (vidocq-workspace#38).
